confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on Aarhus-specific sources: a Numbeo Aarhus listing (header dated Oct 2026, used here for a July 2026 window) and a 2026-titled Hikersbay Aarhus price page, cross-checked against venue menus and undated guides. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are the firmest. Cocktail and wine rest on mixed venue listings rather than a beer-ratio fallback, and happy-hour prices were excluded. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation searches or live listing checks, so July peak-season rates may differ. DKK was converted to USD at an approximate rate that was not separately verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Aarhus-specific listings, so no comparable-city proxy was needed for them. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates for Denmark's second-largest city in peak summer, with no comparable-city data searched.
